I am an old man of 76 years, and I have farmed this land in Shinyanga all my life without schooling. My plot is large — over 13 hectares — but I have no money for chemical fertilizer or hybrid seeds, and the rains here are not reliable enough to plant everything well. I will use the seeds I saved from last harvest, intercrop as my father taught me, and put what little manure my cattle give onto the weakest parts of the field. At my age I cannot work all this land alone, so my sons and grandchildren help, and during weeding and harvest I pay a few neighbors with food or a small amount of money.
